name: guml-vscode
description: GUML language support: the compiler's own diagnostics, formatting and highlighting.

guml.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `guml-lsp` binary. Empty means look on `PATH`, then in `target/release` and `target/debug` of the workspace — which is where `cargo build -p guml-lsp` puts it.

guml.formatOnSave.markdownDescription: Format with the compiler's own formatter on save. Never changes meaning: an AST-preservation test enforces that.

guml.fixAllOnSave.markdownDescription:
Apply every unambiguous compiler suggestion on save. Equivalent to setting `"editor.codeActionsOnSave": { "source.fixAll.guml": "explicit" }` yourself — the server publishes the fix under the standard `source.fixAll` kind, so this is a convenience rather than a second mechanism.

Deliberately **off** by default: it rewrites the document, and a first-run surprise is worse than a keystroke. `guml.repair` is never run on save, because it also *deletes* (a code fence, trailing prose) and silently removing lines on save is indefensible.

commands.title: GUML: Fix all (apply every unambiguous suggestion)

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run gen:grammar && npm run compile
